name: Aadhaar enrolment for a child under 5
name_hi: 5 वर्ष से कम आयु के बच्चे का आधार नामांकन
description: Enrol a resident child up to five years of age for Aadhaar through Head-of-Family based enrolment, using the child's birth certificate and a parent's or legal guardian's Aadhaar.
description_hi: बच्चे के जन्म प्रमाणपत्र और माता-पिता या कानूनी अभिभावक के आधार के साथ परिवार-मुखिया आधारित नामांकन द्वारा पाँच वर्ष तक के निवासी बच्चे का आधार नामांकन कराएँ।
verification_notes: From UIDAI List I (enrolment up to five years). Allowed/not-allowed marks are images, checked visually. Modelled for Head-of-Family based enrolment of resident children; the NRI passport option and document-based enrolment via District Child Protection Officer are not modelled. Biometric authentication by one parent/guardian is mandatory (not a document). Birth registration itself is not in the knowledge base (the official CRS FAQ is disallowed by robots.txt), so a missing birth certificate is reported as a blocker.

requirements.name: Aadhaar number(s) of parent(s) / legal guardian
requirements.name_hi: माता-पिता / कानूनी अभिभावक के आधार नंबर
requirements.notes: Both parents' Aadhaar numbers, or only that of the single parent/legal guardian the child lives with. The Head of Family must hold a valid Aadhaar.

requirements.name: Proof of relationship with the Head of Family (any one)
requirements.name_hi: परिवार-मुखिया से संबंध का प्रमाण (कोई एक)

requirements.name: Proof of date of birth
requirements.notes: Among List I documents for resident children, only the birth certificate is marked as proof of date of birth (a passport applies only to NRIs).
